decision.minimum_next_step: Acquire the source only after authorized FinnGen access; verify R4 manifest row, source bytes, schema/build, and full raw-to-harmonized receipt before any rg analysis.
decision.reason: R9 has 4,235 cases and approximate effective N 16,750 versus R4 1,587 cases and approximate effective N 6,243; both require official access and R4 release-object metadata is not verified.

limitations: No FinnGen R4 summary-statistic bytes or release manifest were acquired in this audit.
The source paper reports R4 cases and controls at cohort level; allele fields, exact R4 object identity, genome build, variant counts, and local checksum remain unverified.

The 2024 combined PD meta-analysis is not treated as independent replication because its European component is the Nalls et al. discovery source; only the separate FinnGen R4 stratum is a potential independent outcome source.
R4 access requires the official request workflow; no form was submitted.
